description:
Welcome to the Rhino Skin Solutions affiliate program! We’re excited to partner with creators, athletes, coaches, gyms, retailers, families, and outdoor lovers who believe in products that help people keep doing what they love.

Rhino Skin Solutions makes high-performance skin care, UPF apparel, and adventure-inspired products for climbers, athletes, kids, families, and anyone who puts their hands and body to work. Our products are made in Redmond, Oregon, and are trusted by active communities for grip support, skin repair, recovery, sun protection, and everyday performance.

From climbing and jiu-jitsu to mountain biking, skiing, sailing, disc golf, gaming, family adventures, and hard-working hands, Rhino products are built for people who push their limits and need gear and skin care that can keep up.

Why partner with Rhino Skin Solutions?

  • USA-made products manufactured in our own facility in Redmond, Oregon
  • Trusted by climbers, athletes, adventurers, families, and active everyday users
  • Strong repeat-purchase potential with practical products customers use often
  • Great fit for content creators, athletes, coaches, gyms, teams, parents, retailers, and outdoor communities
  • Product lineup includes skin repair, grip support, recovery, cleansing, self-care essentials, UPF apparel, and kids books
  • UPF apparel offers comfortable sun protection for training, travel, outdoor work, and everyday adventure
  • Kids books help introduce young readers and families to adventure, confidence, resilience, and the outdoors
  • Easy to promote through reviews, tutorials, training tips, gift guides, family content, outdoor routines, and lifestyle posts
  • A friendly, authentic brand with loyal customers and a strong connection to active communities

What affiliates can promote:

  • Performance, Dry Spray, Tip Juice, and Spit Spray for grip and performance support
  • Repair Cream, Split, and Split+ for hard-working skin
  • Cleanse, Massage Cream, Massage Oil, and self-care products for recovery and daily use
  • Amazing UPF apparel for sun protection, comfort, training, travel, and outdoor adventures
  • Kids books that celebrate adventure, confidence, family, and outdoor fun
  • Bundles, athlete favorites, seasonal products, and giftable essentials
